title: Investigation into Feedback Received on Speeding Vehicles with Modified Engines
what_it_is: Investigation into Feedback Received on Speeding Vehicles with Modified Engines

sections.label: Speeding and illegal modification enforcement
sections.summary: Traffic Police handle speeding enforcement and LTA handles illegal engine modification enforcement, with complaint numbers for 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Enforcement against speeding and the illegal modification of engines is done by the Traffic Police (TP) and Land Transport Authority (LTA) respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2022, TP received about 420 complaints about speeding; LTA received about 3,600 reports on illegal modifications.

sections.label: Penalties for illegally modified vehicles
sections.summary: Registered owners of illegally modified vehicles face charges under section 5 of the Road Traffic Act, with fines, imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The registered owner of an illegally modified vehicle will be charged under section 5 of the Road Traffic Act and liable for a fine of up to $5,000, imprisonment of up to three months, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Investigations typically take approximately eight weeks and can be longer for more complex cases.

sections.label: Acoustic cameras for noise enforcement
sections.summary: There are no plans for acoustic cameras, as attributing noise to specific vehicles is challenging and the technology has limited ability.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to that use of technology, acoustic cameras, currently we have no plans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Unlike a speeding offence, you can capture it with a speed camera visually.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It is challenging to attribute the source of noise to a specific vehicle due to interference from surrounding traffic as well as other sources.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The acoustic cameras, as they are called, I think, still have limited ability in detecting noise violations from individual vehicles accurately and reliably.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, we are monitoring developments in technology in this area and if possible, if useful, we will utilise it, with a view to strengthen enforcement.
